segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Happy Friday, everyone. Let's get the customer meetup sorted, we're three weeks out.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: Three weeks and two days, if we're being precise. It's on 12 December.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Right. First, venue. We have two options, the riverside hall at Ashvattha Grounds and the hotel ballroom.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: The ballroom quoted almost double, and it only fits a hundred and twenty.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: The riverside hall feels more relaxed too. Customers liked outdoor sessions last year.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: Ashvattha has a covered area if it rains, I checked on Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Then we go with the riverside hall at Ashvattha Grounds.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: Agreed, it's the better deal anyway.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Aditya, the booking is still on hold, right?

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: On hold until Tuesday, they won't wait longer than that.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Then please confirm the venue booking by Monday, so we're not cutting it close.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: I'll confirm the booking and pay the advance by Monday.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Next, headcount. Last year we had a hundred and ninety and it felt crowded.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: Sales would love more, they always want more.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: The hall is comfortable up to about one sixty.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Let's cap attendance at 150 people this year, including our own staff.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: Okay, I'll tell sales to be choosy with invites.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: I'll send out the invitations then. I have the list from the CRM.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: When can they go out, Gloria?

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: I'll send the invitations by Friday, once the venue is confirmed.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Friday works, people need two weeks' notice at least.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: Just so everyone knows, I'm on leave on 26 November, so I'll do them before that.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: Can we talk about entertainment? I'd love a live band for the evening.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: A band is at least eighty thousand. That's a big piece of the budget.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: And the hall has a sound limit after nine, I read it in the contract.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: Okay, a playlist then. Forget the band.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Yes, no band this time.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: Food. The caterer offers a buffet with veg and non-veg, or veg only.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: Veg only is cheaper and simpler with the kitchen there.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: Some customers might complain.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: We did veg only two years ago and nobody complained. Let's do a vegetarian buffet.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: Vegetarian buffet, noted. I'll tell the caterer when I confirm the venue.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: What about transport? The hall is forty minutes from the station.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: Last year people struggled to get cabs back at night.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Someone needs to sort out shuttle buses from the station.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: I'm already on venue and catering, so I'd rather not.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: I don't know the transport vendors at all.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Okay, let's find someone for the shuttle buses next week.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: Speakers. Do we have the agenda yet?

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Draft only. Two customer stories and the product roadmap talk.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: Can we ask a customer to do a panel instead of a talk? Panels feel livelier.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Maybe, let me see who's willing first.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: Swag. Do we still have the notebooks from last year?

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: About eighty left in the store room.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Not enough for a hundred and fifty, but let's use them and add some.

segments.speaker: Varun Malik
segments.text: Badges and lanyards too, I can order those, it's cheap.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Thanks Varun, go ahead.

segments.speaker: Aditya Nair
segments.text: Photos? The agency we used last year was good.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Let's ask them for a quote, nothing confirmed yet.

segments.speaker: Gloria Pinto
segments.text: I think that's everything for today.

segments.speaker: Shalini Mukherjee
segments.text: Great work. Have a good weekend, all.

decisions.fact: The meetup is held at the riverside hall at Ashvattha Grounds.

action_items.fact: Aditya confirms the venue booking and pays the advance.
Gloria sends the invitations from the CRM list.
Shuttle buses from the station are arranged; nobody took it on.

distractors.fact: A live band was suggested and dropped.
26 November is Gloria's leave day, not the invitations' due date.
